title: Compile Buffer (unsaved)
summary: Compiles a project with the current editor buffer's unsaved content in place of its file on disk, from a temporary shadow folder, without writing any real file
intro: Read this when you want compiler diagnostics for edits you have not saved yet. By default it copies the unsaved buffer into a temporary shadow folder and compiles the project there, so no real file is written or touched; the old overlay-and-restore behaviour is only available from the command line as ghost-check --in-place.

steps: Edit a unit in the editor without saving
The buffer is staged in a temporary shadow folder and the project compiles there; the file on disk is never written, so there is nothing to restore

questions.ask: How do I get compiler diagnostics for edits I have not saved?
